MLBB meta in November 2026: hero tier list from official statistics

Masha leads the November snapshot with a 60.47% win rate. Hirara has the highest Mythical Glory ban rate at 86.53%.

November tier list

In this story

  1. Hero tier list for November 2026
  2. Highest win rates
  3. Who gets banned the most
  4. Most picked heroes
  5. Heroes in Mythical Glory
  6. The weakest heroes right now

In this story
Hero tier list for November 2026Highest win ratesWho gets banned the mostMost picked heroesHeroes in Mythical GloryThe weakest heroes right now

In short

  • The S tier has 10 heroes: Masha, Marcel, Nolan, Hirara, Kalea, Freya, Obsidia, Aulus, Carmilla and Belerick.
  • Hirara is banned in 84.69% of matches in Mythical Glory over 7 days, while winning 49.52%.
  • Nolan is in S: he is picked in 26.70% of matches in Mythical Glory and banned in 37.12%.
  • In professional drafts over the last month the most present heroes are Masha (100%), Kalea (100%) and Freya (98%): the share of games in which the hero was picked or banned.
  • Masha has the best 30-day win rate at 60.47%, but she appears in only 0.52% of matches.

The tier uses two sources, roughly half each: professional drafts of the last month (Liquipedia, tournaments with prize pools of $10,000 or more) and ranked games in Mythical Glory over 7 days from official MOONTON data (Immortal players included): how often a hero is picked and banned and how well it wins. Data as of 23 November 2026. The tables below are separate 30-day snapshots across all ranks as of 21 November.

Hero tier list for November 2026

The tier is mostly about how contested a hero is. Hirara and Obsidia sit in S with 49.52% and 52.61% wins because they are banned in 84.69% and 64.80% of matches. Esmeralda and Kimmy are often drafted by the pros, but they are rarely banned in ranked and win under 50%, so they are in A, not S. Argus wins 57.32%, but he is rarely picked or banned and the pros did not draft him, so he is in B. The tier ignores hero difficulty and your role: if you play a tier C hero well, there is no need to switch for the number.

Why Masha and Marcel rank so high

Masha wins 60.47% and Marcel 57.49%. But they are rarely picked and often banned: Masha in 40.76% of matches, Marcel in 41.06%. In Mythical Glory the ban rate rises to 72.71% and 71.47% — strong players keep them out of the match.

Frequently asked questions

Which hero is the strongest in MLBB right now?

By the 23 November tier the leaders are Masha, Marcel, Nolan, Hirara and Kalea. By 30-day win rate Masha is first at 60.47%, but she appears in only 0.52% of matches. The tier is refreshed daily on the tier list page.

Who is banned the most in MLBB?

Hirara: she is banned in 68.00% of matches across all ranks and 86.53% in Mythical Glory.

Which heroes are the weakest right now?

Franco, Fanny and Granger, with 41.57% to 43.00% wins over 30 days.
